description: A Jupyter Notebook implementing a semi-automated AI chatbot system using LangChain, OpenAI, and GEMINI models for query and answer generation, with database connectivity and prompt engineering.

classes.name: SQLDatabase
classes.description: A class for managing SQL database connections and queries.

classes.name: GenerativeModel
classes.description: A class representing a generative AI model, such as GEMINI.

methods.name: generate_prompt
methods.description: Creates a prompt string for SQL query generation based on user question and template.

methods.name: openai_model
methods.description: Sends a prompt to OpenAI's chat API and returns the response.

methods.name: get_query
methods.description: Extracts SQL query enclosed in ```sql blocks from model output.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Executes a SQL query against the database and fetches results.

methods.name: generate_final_prompt
methods.description: Creates a comprehensive prompt for answer generation based on user question, SQL, data, and table info.

methods.name: get_text_content
methods.description: Extracts text content from GEMINI model response parts.

methods.name: cost_counter
methods.description: Calculates token-based cost for query and answer outputs.
